data.question: I keep building features nobody uses. Will this actually help?
data.answer: Yes. This volume is specifically about understanding what clients truly need. Requirements discovery, *User-Centered Design*, *Jobs-To-Be-Done*. You'll learn to uncover what users actually need versus what they say they want.

data.question: I don't have time for a **50-page** book...
data.answer: The chapters work as standalone resources. Jump to what you need right now. Got a requirements meeting tomorrow? Read that section. Struggling with stakeholder communication? There's a chapter for that. Plus external links if you want to go deeper.

data.question: Does this teach UX design tools?
data.answer: No. This is about the thinking, not the tools. You'll learn foundational UX principles, requirements discovery techniques, and user-centered thinking. The 'why' and 'what' before the 'how'. If you're looking for Figma tutorials, this isn't it.

data.question: What if I don't find it useful?
data.answer: Email me within **14 days** for a full refund. No hassle. I just ask for a quick note on what didn't work for you so I can make it better.

data.question: What's actually in this volume?
data.answer: Requirements discovery and documentation, *User-Centered Design* principles, *Jobs-To-Be-Done* theory, UX fundamentals (research, personas, design patterns), *Minimum Lovable Products*, *Design Sprints*, and how to write specs that work. Full chapter list and free samples at [dev-concepts.dev](https://dev-concepts.dev).

data.question: Should I get the bundle instead?
data.answer: If you also want [Volume 1](/product/dev-concepts-volume-01) (software craftsmanship, professional mindset), the [Starter Bundle](/product/dev-concepts-starter-bundle) saves you **25%**. Together they cover the two biggest gaps I've seen hold junior developers back.

data.question: Will there be more volumes?
data.answer: Yes, this is part of a **12-volume series**. New volumes come out every few months. Check [dev-concepts.dev](https://dev-concepts.dev) for the Lifetime Bundle if you want all of them as they're released.

data.question: I can't afford this right now...
data.answer: Reach out via Twitter or email. I want to help developers grow, regardless of their financial situation. We'll figure something out.

data.question: Can I buy this for my team?
data.answer: Yes, group licenses are available. Contact me for pricing. Great for teams that want to build the right features and waste less time on rework.
